name: vite-ts-react-migration
title: Migrate to Vite, TypeScript and React 19
description: Replace the no-build CDN import map setup with a Vite + TypeScript + React 19 toolchain: add package.json deps, vite.config.ts and tsconfig.json, move the 13 game modules to .ts with types only (no logic changes), rewrite the 672-line Vue UI layer as React components plus a store, and reuse the 539 lines of CSS unchanged. Acceptance: tsc --noEmit passes in strict mode, npm run build emits a static dist/ that runs from a plain static server, and the five input chains behave identically to the archived baseline.
creator: HelongZhou
